answer_1.quote: We evaluate WPO on instruction following benchmarks, including Alpaca Eval 2 and MT-bench.

answer_2.quote: Alpaca Eval 2 is an automated metric that measures LLMs' alignment with human preferences using 805 representative instructions. For each instruction, the evaluated model's response and gpt-4-turbo's response are compared head-to-head using an auto-evaluator.

answer_3.quote: MT-bench is an LLM-based automated evaluation metric comprising 80 challenging questions. We report results using two scoring methods. In the single answer grading approach, the auto-evaluator (gpt-4-0613) assigns scores from 1 to 10 to responses... In the pairwise comparison approach, the evaluator (gpt-4-0613) compares two responses to decide which is better or if it's a tie.
